fd476c1d-433a-4d7c-9e9f-d808ecef6df1.text:
# Kayani bakery
Shrewsbury biscuits and mawa cakes. Buy a box to bring as a gift. Closed on Tuesdays. Cash only. The biscuits stay fresh for two weeks.

3c580989-853e-4e77-af8f-edc7c368e02f.text:
# Hyderabad House biryani
Best chicken dum biryani I have had in Pune, near FC Road. The rice is very spicy and the masala is heavy, so order raita on the side. Takes 30 minutes on weekends. Costs about 350 rupees for one plate that two people can share. Go before 8 pm or it sells out.

91a9b75e-9e04-4a26-917c-d5fc29257ae6.text:
# Atomic Habits
Main idea: tiny changes repeated daily compound. Make the habit obvious, easy, attractive and satisfying. Two minute rule: start by doing only two minutes. Habit stacking: after coffee, I stretch. Reread chapter 3.

53996bf1-8db7-4079-8c46-3afbb49698df.text:
# Deep Work
Protect long blocks of focus, two to four hours with no phone. Schedule them like meetings. Shallow work (email, chat) goes into a small window. I try morning blocks 9 to 11.

19605e9a-ebdd-4c67-9771-d8b09c590c2d.text:
# The Psychology of Money
Wealth is what you do not spend. Savings rate matters more than returns early. Avoid comparing with others. Keep an emergency fund of six months. A good book to give to a friend who just got his first job.

7e9c5823-0c14-4e43-bb0b-7ae4fb11a5e5.text:
# Bike and car service
Bike service every 3000 km, last done in August. Car insurance renews in March. The nearest service centre is on Baner road and is closed on Mondays. Tyre pressure check every month.

d3e05953-42a1-40c0-8fcd-394fa7338339.text:
# Elco pani puri and chaat
Sev puri and pani puri on Bibwewadi side. Mild and sweet, not spicy, so good for guests who do not like heat. Evening only after 5 pm. About 100 rupees for a full plate.

a4bc5e10-bac1-45f1-9249-f6f23378026d.text:
# Highway dhaba on the Mumbai road
Dal tadka and butter naan, very oily but tasty. Stop here on the way to Mumbai, about 80 km from Pune. Clean toilets, which matters. Chicken curry is very spicy and the dal is milder.

metadata.title: Highway dhaba on the Mumbai road

dc4a9830-4b4c-423c-b3b2-9e661c897305.text:
# Diet notes
Eat protein with every meal: eggs, paneer, dal, curd. Cut sugary drinks. Fruits as snacks, not chips. Have a cheat meal on Saturday and do not feel guilty. Water, at least 3 litres a day.

7b797f3f-5b1d-4d03-87b1-3f592263f2aa.text:
# Annual health checkup
Book the full body checkup in January. Blood sugar, vitamin D and B12 were low last year. Dr Mehta's clinic is on Karve Road, appointments only. Fasting required for 10 hours before the blood test.

12a2dc01-15e6-45e7-940a-9ea0a0bef5b5.text:
# Sagar dosa
Crispy ghee roast dosa, big and thin. Sambar is slightly sweet. Good for a light dinner. Busy after 7 pm. Try the mysore masala dosa too, it has a red chutney layer that is very spicy.

3f2b0ab2-8bda-4a80-a7b3-abd9e16c9c67.text:
# Vaishali filter coffee
Great filter coffee and idli-vada for breakfast. Always crowded around 9 am. Cash is easier. Coffee is strong and sweet, 60 rupees. Good place to meet someone early.

e1339104-4c5f-4de0-a862-227856f48dea.text:
# Gift ideas for friends
Rahul: a good water bottle, he is into hiking. Sneha: a book, she reads fiction. Dad: a new reading lamp. Keep a budget of 2000 each. Order early in October because of Diwali delays.

58791068-b5b1-45c5-a4a2-5de0e68cce91.text:
# Gym plan
Mon chest and triceps, Tue back and biceps, Wed legs, Thu rest, Fri shoulders and abs, Sat light cardio, Sun rest. Three sets of ten reps. Increase weight by 2 kg once the last set feels easy. Start with a 10 minute warm up, always.

d97d8126-9e9b-4a0d-a111-9bf20c153db9.text:
# Natural ice cream
Custard apple and tender coconut flavours are the best. Skip the chocolate. Good after a spicy meal. Open till 11 pm, so a good late-night stop after a movie.

3ba9ec72-b185-4291-b1f8-7cdaf1b22b5d.text:
# Idea: expense tracker
Add an expense in one sentence ("auto 120"), categories done automatically, weekly summary on Sunday. Maybe connect to UPI messages. Check if an MCP server for it exists already, there is one in my folder.

c9c85143-14d6-4c31-a2d7-5fda7ba55080.text:
# Idea: weekly newsletter
Write about what I learn in AI each week, ten lines only. Start with a free platform. First topics: prompts, caching, why RAG exists. Publish every Sunday so it becomes a habit.

728d5a09-30ad-46c3-bd9e-2abe802c08e7.text:
# Idea: reels and videos collector
Save useful YouTube and Instagram videos with a short summary, so I can search them later. Transcripts are the easy part, Instagram is blocked often. Start with YouTube only.

0b345f6c-f852-44b1-9d91-05ee3f09fd9a.text:
# Idea: my own voice friend
A voice assistant that remembers everything: reminders, meals, mood, notes. It should talk like a friend, not a robot, and not nag. The hard part is memory: what to keep, what to search, when to forget.

a8df8d04-e690-4363-adea-0b003ed97a05.text:
# Interview prep
Be ready to explain every project in the resume: what I built, what broke, what I measured. Common questions: what is RAG, what is prompt caching, how do you test an LLM app. Mock interview with Sneha on Saturday.

c207e4c7-0017-4b11-86c9-4b757afdff7c.text:
# Learning goals for the next 3 months
Finish the AI engineering course in order. One module a day, build something each time. Two interview-style projects on GitHub. Write down what broke and why, that is the real learning.

metadata.title: Learning goals for the next 3 months

01534638-9f55-42a5-a25d-f5b8bcc03806.text:
# Standup notes, Monday
Done: the reminder API and tests. Blocked: the docker database port clash. Next: write the docs for the injection tests. Decision: keep one database for reminders and later notes.

b9e0fd24-ad9c-47f2-802a-e9f0d4f061db.text:
# Weekend plan
Saturday gym in the morning, then lunch with Rahul at the thali place. Sunday: laundry and a long run. Call mom in the evening.

50fd431f-ad18-47a2-9202-44021e9e2234.text:
# Cafe list

Blue Tokai for work, good wifi and quiet. German Bakery for a casual chat. Both open by 8 am.

Third Wave on Koregaon Park is too noisy.

4b8bb2a9-cd36-4169-a1c4-0f6bb3ec3222.text:
# Bedekar Misal
Classic Pune misal pav in Narayan Peth. Very spicy kat (the spicy gravy), ask for less if you cannot handle heat. Closes at 1 pm. Go on a weekday, the Sunday queue is long. The curd on the side saves you.

2d937cbe-b293-4253-aecf-da9a8033af74.text:
# Mom's birthday
March 14. Last year we did a family dinner. This year, a gift: a silk saree or a smartwatch for health tracking. Book the restaurant a week early. She likes surprises but not loud parties.

5a0f6e6f-871e-46ec-b4e3-523ebe32706f.text:
# Movies to watch
Interstellar rewatch, Lapataa Ladies, 12th Fail, Tumbbad. Watch the long ones on a Saturday night, not a weekday. Tumbbad is horror, so not with mom.

7b6a9cfe-999c-4266-bb04-9b637f5ef3fd.text:
# Playlists
Focus: lo-fi and old Hindi instrumentals. Gym: Punjabi high energy. Drive: Arijit Singh, A R Rahman hits. Do not use anything with lyrics while coding.

6edf7dd4-6e66-4a61-abcf-23d09b20397f.text: quick thought: the best time to call dad is after 8 pm when he is back from the walk. do not call during lunch. remind him about the doctor appointment on friday.

e46861a9-034a-4565-8fc5-ed308d8b2cd8.text:
# Packing list for long trips
Passport, charger and power bank, two pairs of shoes, basic medicines (paracetamol, ORS, band aids), a small first aid kit, rain jacket, reusable water bottle. Print the hotel bookings. Keep 2000 rupees in cash separate from the wallet.

7fc876b7-c30f-43c0-b25c-77f7b1a17c9e.text:
# Passport renewal
Expires in 8 months. Book the slot on the Passport Seva site. Documents: Aadhaar, old passport, address proof, photos. Police verification may not be needed for a renewal. Allow two weeks.

b544a81d-3eec-4a8a-8519-df654aadeb68.text:
# Podcasts
Lex Fridman for long interviews, Latent Space for AI engineering, The Ranveer Show for Indian founders. Listen at 1.5x speed while walking or in traffic. Delete the episodes after finishing, or storage fills up.

ff3d7dad-b6e1-4da6-88ef-609f95d3dbe4.text:
# Capstone project notes
The agent has tools for reminders and check-ins, a prompt that was tested and shortened, and tests for injection. Next: search over my notes. Keep a docs file for every decision, with the reason, not only the result.

76ef7955-21a0-46d0-b6f7-9835981890d3.text:
# Python tips I keep forgetting
Path.stem gives the file name without the extension. Use dataclasses for small records. enumerate instead of range(len(x)). f-strings for formatting. Use virtual environments for every project. Run python -m package.module from the project root.

6509f591-6595-4ca6-a96d-134b41ba7fb2.text:
# RAG notes
RAG means find the right pieces of text first, then give them to the model. Steps: load, clean, split into chunks, embed, store, search, answer with citations. If search is bad, the answer is bad, so test search separately from the model.

cf06dc5e-200e-4454-bd2c-81a1669820ed.text:
# Perfect chai
Boil water with crushed ginger and cardamom, then add tea leaves, then milk and sugar. Boil twice and strain. Not too much sugar. Masala chai powder from the Pune market is better than the packet kind.

1024b5d8-4def-4b76-82ab-e74b5fbd1491.text:
# Dal tadka
Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric for four whistles. Tadka of ghee, cumin, garlic, dried red chillies and tomatoes. Add garam masala at the end. Serve with rice and a pickle. Makes enough for two days.

f9365942-f359-4d14-99f0-b3d6f2dc23a3.text:
# Egg bhurji
Quick dinner for late nights. Onion, tomato, green chilli, turmeric, and three eggs. Cook for 5 minutes. Have it with pav or roti. Spicy if you add the full chilli, so use half if mom is eating.

4d1ef505-1a31-4253-805d-5a900a5324cb.text:
# Poha recipe
Rinse poha and let it rest. Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves, onions, peanuts and turmeric. Mix in the poha with salt and a little sugar. Finish with lemon, coriander and sev. Ready in 15 minutes. Mild, not spicy.

c9efc843-8ef0-4962-aece-c99fb2759278.text:
# Rent and bills
Rent due on the 5th, 18,000 rupees. Electricity bill around the 12th, wifi on the 20th. Pay by UPI and screenshot it. The landlord increases the rent by 5 percent in April, so ask early about extending the agreement.

3fc60895-574c-4712-9d37-ac0efefdfcb9.text:
# 10K run goal
Train for the Pune half marathon in February. Run three times a week: easy 5K, intervals, long run on Sunday. Add 1 km to the long run each week. Buy new running shoes, the old pair has 800 km on it. Stretch after every run.

c782d58f-d9cb-40fc-8694-bf585423e7cc.text:
# Side income ideas
Freelance small AI automations for local shops, like WhatsApp reply bots. Charge per project, not per hour. Need three testimonials first. Build one demo for a clinic that books appointments.

873741b2-0f6d-4720-88e6-37ddf61a2519.text:
# Sleep notes
Sleeping before 11 pm makes the next day much better. Coffee after 3 pm ruins the night. Phone out of the bedroom helped for two weeks, then I slipped. Target: 7 hours. Less than 6 hours makes me irritable and I skip the gym.

30642a5f-a392-44ba-80cd-de8708e4d849.text:
# Names for the project
Friend, Saathi, Yaar, Dost. Saathi sounds warm, Yaar is too casual. Check that the domain is free. Not important right now, ship first.

b69b7339-c458-408b-a066-ea9831d45ccc.text:
# Back stretching routine
Desk job back pain gets better with ten minutes of stretching: cat-cow, child's pose, hip flexor stretch and a doorway chest stretch. Do it after waking up. Stand and walk every hour at work.

76bf4882-33ed-4646-9efa-2244c8d9cd5f.text:
# Sushi place in Bandra
Went for Rahul's birthday. Expensive, around 2500 per person. Salmon rolls were good, the vegetarian options are limited. Book ahead. Not a regular spot, only for celebrations.

38d71ec5-6e97-4e73-bd76-605d363e343e.text:
# Shreyas thali
Unlimited Maharashtrian thali, 450 rupees. Comes with puran poli on festival days. Best place to take parents. Book a table, there is a wait on Sunday afternoons. Vegetarian only.

112a07a9-a335-4aed-867e-f6b3f2b758a0.text:
# Goa trip plan
Plan: 4 days in November, the weather is dry then. Stay in North Goa near Anjuna, rent a scooter. Do the Chapora fort sunset and Saturday night market. Avoid Baga beach, too crowded. Budget 25,000 for two. Book the train early, Mandovi Express fills up.

c57e614b-6069-4dca-8c94-8fe2fe6aaaa6.text:
# Hampi
Two days is enough. Rent a cycle, go to Virupaksha temple at sunrise and Matanga hill at sunset. Stay in Hospet or Anegundi side. Good for photography. Bring a hat, very little shade.

c55ec59c-3e0b-4fe8-8e01-d0db51c226eb.text:
# Jaipur weekend
Amber fort early in the morning before the crowd, then Hawa Mahal from the cafe opposite. Eat laal maas and ghewar. Hotel near MI Road. Winter is the best time, summer is brutal at 45 degrees. Wear comfortable shoes, the fort has long climbs.

73e0a6d7-0d44-46e0-9274-2509ba7f2794.text:
# Kerala backwaters
Alleppey houseboat for one night, around 9000 rupees for two with food. Fish curry and appam on the boat. Monsoon is cheap but rainy. Combine with Munnar for tea gardens and cool weather. Mosquito repellent needed.

61b9ec2c-c4c2-4755-80fe-4282125b3809.text:
# Manali in December
Snow at Solang valley, but roads can close. Carry thermals, gloves and a power bank because the cold drains batteries. Take a Volvo bus from Delhi overnight. Avoid the Rohtang pass trip in winter, it is closed.

878f4ca3-d0e7-440b-815d-7ffb7f05b25e.text:
# Rishikesh
Rafting in September after the monsoon, the Ganges is full. Yoga ashram stay costs little. Evening aarti at Triveni Ghat. Vegetarian and no alcohol in the town. Go with friends for the adventure bits.

fe609764-0373-47be-bc0b-1e822df1cce7.text:
# Udaipur
Lake Pichola boat ride at sunset. City Palace takes two hours. Stay in a haveli near the lake. Try dal baati churma. Good for a romantic trip, and we could take mom and dad too.

8fa17ccf-5129-4b80-960a-e4ca6acc4ffa.text:
# Wifi problems
Router reset fixes the slowdown. The password is on the sticker under the router. The speed drops in the evening, call the provider and ask for a technician visit. The ticket number is saved in my messages.
